remarks: For the first time on the market, 5.1-acres presents a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity in the 4-acre zone of North Greenwich. Expansive, open, and impeccably level, the land captivates at every turn, offering a serene and private canvas. Nestled among distinguished homes, mature orchards, and country clubs, this property combines natural beauty with unparalleled convenience. Residents enjoy proximity to private schools, premier shopping and dining, and effortless access to the Merritt Parkway and I684. This extraordinary parcel invites visionary design and limitless possibilities, making it a rare gem in Greenwich. An oversized canvas for your architectural aspirations, it is perfect for creating a home that reflects your dreams. Home is occupied; DO NOT WALK THE PROPERTY all showings by appointment only and accompanied by listing agent. Home is offered, as-is.
